summary: Moderate tier in the July 2026 legal-risk assessment (grouped with Kentucky and North Carolina): one or two laws aimed at transgender adults or several aimed at youth, but no adult facility ban recorded and no protective statute. Slightly below the national score 0.36.

sources.summary: Erin In The Morning's anti-trans national legal-risk assessment map, July 2026 update (reposted by Stonewall News): Alaska appears in the Moderate-Risk group (AK, KY, NC) — states that "have either passed one or two laws aimed at transgender adults or have enacted multiple laws targeting transgender youth, or are advancing negative laws quickly" — above the worst-law and do-not-travel tiers and below the protective/safe groupings.
